actionAdapters.entry: project-confirmed Sound source and business sound trigger
actionAdapters.when: 只修改已冻结的声音源行、业务触发和停止 / 释放生命周期

actionAdapters.entry: SoundComponentInspector, AudioClip, BundleCollectorSetting and existing trigger target editing
actionAdapters.when: 更新已确认的 SoundComponent、组壳、Mixer、AudioClip、Collector 或既有触发目标
冻结 active ConfigMaster、YooAssetEditorConfigsMask 与 target Platform/Channel/DevelopMode 后，按解析出的 BundleCollectorSettingPath 定位既有 Collector；解析为空、漂移或与确认 Collector 不一致时 blocked
导出已冻结 Sound Unit 的数据、类型或完整确认范围
在 Play Mode 中加载、确认目标组、触发并验证停止或释放责任
等待异步 AudioClip 加载后检查目标 AudioSource 播放与停止

allow: confirmed Sound source rows and selected data or type output
confirmed AudioClip asset, existing Collector membership and address
confirmed SoundComponent, SoundSettings, SoundGroupShell or AudioMixer settings through Unity Editor or MCP
confirmed existing business sound trigger and its stop or release lifecycle
confirmed existing target Prefab binding directly related to the sound trigger
deny: handwritten Unity asset, Prefab, Scene or meta YAML
manual edits to generated Sound JSON, bytes or C# output
placeholder, generated or unconfirmed AudioClip, Collector, Package or address
unrelated Sound Unit, Collector, Package, AudioMixer, UI layout, View, UIGroup or registration
export.excel.all, CDN deployment, Bundle or Player build, Framework Sound API, Manager or Inspector changes

requiredFor: ambiguous Sound source, Unit, Name, AudioClip, Collector, Package, address, group, Mixer, AgentCount, load entry or runtime success probe
active ConfigMaster、YooAssetEditorConfigsMask、target Platform/Channel/DevelopMode、有效 YooAssetSettingsPath 或 BundleCollectorSettingPath 不明确、漂移或与确认 Collector 不一致
change data format, source or output path, SoundGroupShell, AudioMixer, Collector, Package, address, existing audio asset, business trigger or lifecycle
replace a non-generated asset, create or change an existing target Prefab binding, remove a source row or clean generated output
delete, external write, credential use, Bundle or Player build, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: 确认激活 ConfigMaster、YooAssetEditorConfigsMask、target Platform/Channel/DevelopMode、ResolveYooAsset 的有效路径、真实 AudioClip、唯一地址、Sound 表和导出范围、SoundComponent 加载入口、声音组、业务触发与停止生命周期、实际播放成功探针及最小写入集；任一输入或范围变化后旧确认失效。

evidence: 冻结的 active ConfigMaster、YooAssetEditorConfigsMask、target Platform/Channel/DevelopMode、ResolveYooAsset 有效路径，以及 Sound 表行、AudioClip、Collector、Package、地址和声音组映射
定向 Exporter 或已确认 Sound Batch 的暂存发布与 Unity 编译证据
Play Mode 中 Nova.Sound.LoadAsync、HasSoundGroup、业务触发和实际 AudioSource 播放证据
BGM 停止或 SFX 停止 / ReleaseAssetBySerialID 的生命周期证据
